name: Hexodus
description: A hexagonal escape puzzle: each tile carries an arrow, and it can only leave when every hex along that ray is empty. One hundred solver-verified Journey boards across eight chapters introduce keys, frost and rotating arrows, alongside a shared daily challenge, endless Zen and Classic stages. Every board is generated from a seed and checked solvable before it ships.
highlights: 100 solver-verified Journey levels across eight chapters
Locks and keys, frost that thaws from the edges, and arrows that turn with their neighbours
A daily board seeded from the UTC date, identical on every device
Undo, solver-backed hints, four themes and reduced-motion support
howToPlay: Tap a tile: it escapes only if every hex on its arrow ray is empty.
A blocked tile shakes and the first blocker pulses — no penalty.
Keys open matching padlocks; frost thaws when neighbours leave.
levels: 100 Journey levels · 8 chapters + daily, Zen and Classic
